Windy City Cycling Club Sunday Morning Ride

Chicago, IL · Edgewater · Road

LGBTQ+

Windy City Cycling Club Sunday Morning Ride is a road group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Foster Ave & Lakefront Trail. About 40–45 miles, cruising 15–17 mph and fast 18+ mph groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @wcccrolls the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Windy City Cycling Club Sunday Morning Ride group ride

The longer, faster ride from Chicago's LGBTQA+ cycling club. Leaves Foster Beach and heads up the North Shore toward Fort Sheridan. Two pace groups. RSVP on Meetup.
